task_completion.description: The agent successfully loads the thoracolumbar spine CT scan into the medical imaging software (e.g., 3Slicer).
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing a CT scan of a spine loaded in the multi-planar reconstruction (MPR) views (Axial, Sagittal, Coronal).

task_completion.description: The agent identifies and navigates to the L1 vertebral level for assessment.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The crosshairs or slice view focused on the L1 vertebra, often indicated by counting from the sacrum or rib-bearing T12.

task_completion.description: The agent uses measurement tools to mark the anterior and posterior heights of the L1 vertebral body.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Visual rulers, calipers, or markup points placed on the anterior and posterior borders of the L1 vertebral body in the sagittal view.

task_completion.description: The agent saves the measurements to the specified JSON markup file path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file browser dialog or terminal output showing the creation/saving of '~/Documents/SlicerData/Spine/vertebral_measurements.mrk.json'.

task_completion.description: The agent creates a final report file with the required fields: vertebral_level, anterior_height_mm, posterior_height_mm, compression_ratio, genant_grade, and morphology.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal 'cat' command displaying '~/Documents/SlicerData/Spine/fracture_report.json' containing the calculated values and Genant Grade 2.

integrity.description: The agent performed measurements using the imaging software's GUI tools rather than just writing a script to generate the output.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the mouse cursor interacting with measurement tools or markup points visible on the CT slices.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply echo the privileged information into the report without opening the image.
integrity.visual_evidence: The sequence of screenshots must show the CT scan being opened and manipulated before the report is generated.

integrity.description: The compression ratio and Genant grade in the report match the visual evidence of the fracture seen in the CT.
integrity.visual_evidence: The sagittal view should clearly show a wedge-shaped or compressed L1 vertebra consistent with the reported ~31% reduction (Grade 2).

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target vertebra is L1. The ground truth Genant classification is Grade 2 (moderate), representing a height reduction between 25% and 40% (specifically ~31%). Measured heights should fall within the 10.8mm to 30.0mm range. The final report must be saved to ~/Documents/SlicerData/Spine/fracture_report.json.
